_metadata.title: SRCP - Resource Projects and Allocations
_metadata.description: Cambridge Secure Research Computing Platform (SRCP): organizations buy storage, compute and desktop capacity as accounts, then divide it between SRCP projects (resource projects) with their own limits, data owners, data managers, project managers and users. Shows aggregate, per-project and unrestricted limit policies and a purchase history with PO numbers.
scenarios: Aggregate limit policy (project sizes add up to the purchased capacity)
Offering-specific roles: Data Owner, Data Manager, Project Manager, Project User
Storage purchase and renewal history with PO numbers

offerings.name: Research Data Store (RDS)
offerings.description: Resilient storage for active research data. An account buys capacity in TB and divides it between its SRCP projects; together the projects cannot exceed what was bought.
offerings.getting_started:
## Getting started with {resource_name}

Platform ID: `{backend_id}`

Each SRCP project of this store is mounted on your SRCP platforms at `/rds/{backend_id}/<project-id>`.

Upload or download data through the Data Management Server (University network or VPN, SSH key registered under My access):

```
sftp <crsid>@data-{backend_id}.srcp.hpc.cam.ac.uk
```

Support: rcs-support@cam.ac.uk

offerings.name: Research Cold Store (RCS)
offerings.description: Low-cost archive storage for data that is rarely accessed. Capacity is bought in TB per account and shared out between projects.
offerings.getting_started:
## Getting started with {resource_name}

Platform ID: `{backend_id}`

Archive and retrieve data through the transfer service:

```
sftp <crsid>@rcs-transfer.srcp.hpc.cam.ac.uk:/{backend_id}/
```

Retrievals from tape can take several hours.

Support: rcs-support@cam.ac.uk

offerings.name: Virtual HPC (vHPC)
offerings.description: Isolated SLURM cluster for processing sensitive data. Each project gets its own quota, which may not exceed the allocation of the cluster.
offerings.getting_started:
## Getting started with {resource_name}

Platform ID: `{backend_id}`

Log in from the University network or the VPN with your Raven password and SRCP two-factor code:

```
ssh <crsid>@vhpc-{backend_id}.srcp.hpc.cam.ac.uk
```

Move data in and out through this platform's Data Management Server:

```
sftp <crsid>@data-{backend_id}.srcp.hpc.cam.ac.uk
```

List software with `module avail` and submit jobs with `sbatch`.

Support: rcs-support@cam.ac.uk

offerings.name: Secure Windows Desktop
offerings.description: Windows virtual desktops with statistics software, without internet access. Each project on a platform gets its own shared drive.
offerings.getting_started:
## Getting started with {resource_name}

Platform ID: `{backend_id}`

Open the Citrix Workspace app (a browser will not work) and sign in at https://desktop.srcp.cam.ac.uk with your Microsoft two-factor code.

Your projects are under `X:\SRCP`. Import data through the Import space of the project in the web portal; a Manager moves it in.

Support: rcs-support@cam.ac.uk
